params.body:
The order form showed the detail gallery of the public frame page: model shots, the jewel close-ups, everything flagged for the detail page. The cart then showed a different image again. A dealer picks a size and a colour on the order form; the browsing happened on the frame page before that. So the order flow now carries one photo, the same one everywhere.

## What changed

- **One photo in the order flow.** The full order page and the order window in the grid show the frame's order-overview photo: the photo flagged "Tonen op besteloverzicht" in the Studio (`showOnIndex`, at most one per frame), or the frame's first photo when none is flagged, so the form is never empty.
- **Same photo in the cart.** The cart line snapshot goes through the same helper (`Content::orderPhoto`), so the cart, the order overview and the confirmation mail show what the form showed.
- **Public frame page unchanged.** The detail gallery stays where it belongs. The fallback for a website frame block without a chosen photo also stays the order-overview photo, as before.

The Studio's own wording follows in hoet-sanity: the toggle "Tonen op overzicht" becomes "Tonen op besteloverzicht", since that is what it decides.

## Verification

- `ConfiguratorTest`: the order page and the order window show the overview photo and not the detail photo; a frame without the flag falls back to its first photo.
- Pint, PHPStan and the suite pass. `BuildStampTest` fails in a git worktree only (the branch ref lives in the common git dir); it passes in a normal checkout and in CI.
params.title: Show one photo in the order form: the order-overview photo
